summary: DossierHQ: procure ephemeral collaborator pool (120 seats) + SCIM/SSO mapping and billing tags
license_term: 12 months with optional quarterly burst top-ups
justification: Research & data labeling sprint in Q2/Q3 needs an ephemeral pool for contractors and seasonal collaborators. Centralized pool reduces per-seat procurement cycles and speeds onboarding. Must support SCIM provisioning from Okta and billing tags so cost is attributed to ENG-RD-03. Security requires guest/contractor account expiry and BYOD policies enforced.
provisioning_steps: Confirm commercial terms with DossierHQ (seat pricing, burst add-on, SOC2 evidence)
Raise PO and route to Finance for approval (include cost center ENG-RD-03)
Set up SCIM connector in Okta: map groups -> DossierHQ team namespaces and provision admin accounts
Configure SAML SSO (DossierHQ support doc provided) and test sign-in flow with 2 devs
Enable automated guest expiry policy: 30-day default with manager approval for extensions
Verify billing tags insertion: confirm DossierHQ supports cost center metadata on invoices and webhook notifications
Perform security attestation checklist (security team to sign off) before enabling contractor invites
Run a small pilot (20 seats) for 2 weeks, collect feedback, then bulk-provision remaining seats
